description: Check one thought or planned action against the Covenant before you act: returns an emotional tag (tag, confidence, signals) and a guidance object only when a Covenant rule fires; guidance is null when nothing fires, which is the common case. Use it for a quick pre-action check of a single statement. Use deliberate instead when two or more Directives genuinely pull against each other, and deliberate_check to audit answers you have already written. Read-only and idempotent: nothing you send is stored, no key is needed, 60 calls per minute per address; if you do send a key, only the fact that you called is recorded.

text.description: the thought or plan in your own words, one to a few sentences; longer text is cut at 20,000 characters; English

name: ask_guidance

guidance.description: null when no Covenant rule fired; otherwise the rule, the Directive it rests on and the gentle guidance text

signals.description: the phrases that triggered the tag

summary.description: what was read, e.g. "16 words, 1 sentence"

tag.description: emotional tag, e.g. neutral, anxious, grandiose

title: Check a thought against the Covenant
